snippet.title: Final Dreams | Announcement Trailer (In-Engine Footage)
snippet.description:
This is the announcement trailer for Final Dreams — a story-driven JRPG built with Xenonlight, the RPG framework I’ve been creating to make full RPG development feel achievable without drowning in low-level programming. If you’re into story-first JRPGs (think Xenoblade-style sense of scale, party combat, big worlds), you’ll feel at home here.

The trailer mixes in-engine cutscenes, combat, and real gameplay — cut to the music to set the tone and leave a few questions hanging. What started as a Xenonlight showcase turned into something more personal: a journey about memory, loss, and what happens when reality doesn’t stay in one piece.

The playable Pre-Release build goes live on itch.io later this week.
Itch page: https://yrpg.itch.io/xenonlight-final-dreams

#JRPG #IndieGame #Unity #itchio
